title: balsamorhiza macrophylla var. terebinthacea
intro: Balsamorhiza macrophylla var. terebinthacea, commonly known as Mountain Balsamroot, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, alleviating respiratory problems, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Balsamroot include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which help to relieve coughs, reduce swelling, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
